title: Beneath the Altar
next_chapter_hook: Chen Nian's message struck like thunder, and something that had slumbered for a thousand years deep within the altar seemed to have been awakened by her sacrifice...

text.content: The corridor of the altar was as dark as ink. Chen Ji's fire starter cast a dim yellow glow around him. The walls were covered with ancient inscriptions, the characters twisted and eerie, like some forgotten language. He had walked underground for half an hour, the air growing colder and colder, carrying a faint scent of blood. Ahead, the first stone door finally appeared.

The stone door was half-open, a faint silver light seeping through the gap. Chen Ji's pupils contracted. This silver light... was the trace of Spiritual Energy fluctuation. He didn't rush in, but took out a talisman from his chest, gently activating it with Spiritual Energy to confirm there were no traps before squeezing through sideways. The depths of the altar were much vaster than imagined, with broken jade bottles and talisman paper scattered across the floor, as if someone had performed some kind of ritual here.

dialogue.content: The arrangement here... is not the style of the Demonic Path.

text.content: Chen Ji crouched down, his fingertips brushing the dust on the ground. Beneath the dust were delicate carved marks—those were sword traces, but the sword intent was gentle and exquisite, definitely not left by a man. His heart sank heavily. His sister Chen Nian cultivated the 'Blue Phoenix Sword Technique,' and the sword traces of this technique were exactly like this. He looked up sharply—the source of the silver light was right on the altar platform in the center of the altar.

The altar platform was built from white jade, about three chi high. On its surface was an undeniably deep sword mark, shaped like a phoenix spreading its wings. Beside the sword mark lay a fist-sized blood-colored crystal stone, emanating a faint silver glow. Chen Ji walked forward, and the moment his finger touched the crystal stone, a familiar aura rushed into his Mental Sea.

dialogue.content: Brother, if you can sense this Blood Pact Crystal, it means I have completed the first step.

text.content: The voice was gentle yet clear—it was Chen Nian's voice! Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly. This was his sister's message technique, using blood as the medium and pact as the lock, sealing the words she wanted to say in a specific object. He forced himself to remain calm, continuing to inject Spiritual Energy into the crystal. More images flooded into his mind like a tide.

In the vision, Chen Nian, dressed in plain white clothing, stood before the same altar platform. Her face was pale as paper, with bloodstains still visible at the corner of her mouth—she was clearly already severely injured. But her eyes were exceptionally calm, even carrying a hint of relieved smile.

dialogue.content: I know about your fake death plan, and I know you still think my capture by the Holy Sect was an accident. Brother, you overestimate those wastes too much.

text.content: Chen Ji's whole body froze. The fake death plan was his final trump card—he had never told anyone. How did his sister know? The vision continued to flow, Chen Nian's figure turned toward the back of the altar, where a pitch-black rift was slowly expanding—that was a temporal-spatial rift.

dialogue.content: The fourth page of the Tianji Record is sealed by the Heavenly Dao's will deep within the temporal-spatial rift. The Holy Sect wanted to capture me, not because I have the Chen family bloodline, but because I am your Heavenly Fate Key—my existence can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight. Brother, your destiny cannot be carried by you alone.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's message continued. Facing the fact that his sister already knew everything, what was Chen Ji's choice?

choices.description: Continuing to listen would shake Chen Ji's Dao heart, but the truth was right before his eyes.

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers gripped the Blood Pact Crystal tightly. He wanted to interrupt this message, yet couldn't bear to sever the only connection with his sister. He closed his eyes, letting tears fall silently, and continued to listen.

choices.description: Stay calm, record all information for subsequent action.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing his emotions down to the deepest part of his Mental Sea. He began using his divine sense to record every detail of this message while analyzing the information it contained. His sister voluntarily entered the temporal-spatial rift to find the fourth page of the Tianji Record—this behavior itself was fraught with strangeness.

In the vision, Chen Nian turned around, looking directly into the void, as if she could see Chen Ji at this very moment through time and space. Her eyes held no resentment, only endless tenderness and a trace of apology.

dialogue.content: You always say I'm foolish, say I'd help someone count their money even after they sold me. But brother, you're the most foolish one. Carrying the vengeance of our destroyed clan alone, carrying the curse of the Tianji Record, carrying everyone's schemes—aren't you tired?

text.content: Chen Ji's lips trembled slightly. In the vision, several black shadows appeared behind Chen Nian—those were pursuers from the Holy Sect. Yet she didn't look back. Instead, she thrust the sword in her hand into the altar platform, and the Spiritual Energy on the sword surged out like a tide, forming barriers around the altar.

dialogue.content: The Holy Sect's people are here. Brother, I don't have much time. I want to tell you one last thing—after entering the temporal-spatial rift, I will use myself as the medium to seal part of the Tianji Record's aura. This way, the Heavenly Fate consumption when you use the Tianji Record will be greatly reduced. But the price is... I may never be able to return.

text.content: Chen Ji's fingernails dug deep into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers. He wanted to shout to stop her, wanted to tell her not to do this, but the message technique was one-way. He could only watch helplessly as his sister in the vision showed a relieved smile.

Chen Nian looked at him one last time. That gaze contained too much—thirteen years of longing, the pain of being unable to recognize each other, and the deepest love a sister could have for her brother. Then, she turned and leaped into that pitch-black temporal-spatial rift, her figure instantly swallowed. The barriers activated simultaneously, blocking all pursuers outside.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's message ended here. Her cultivation traces and that Blood Pact Crystal remained in the depths of the altar. What should Chen Ji do now?

choices.description: His sister entered the temporal-spatial rift to find the fourth page—he must find a way to follow her in.
choices.process_label: 陈机开始探查裂隙痕迹

text.content: Chen Ji wiped the tears from his face, his eyes regaining their cold, sharp edge. He began carefully searching the altar, trying to find the traces his sister left when she entered the temporal-spatial rift. The Blood Pact Crystal pulsed warmly, as if guiding him in his search.

choices.description: This was his sister's last memento left for him, and the only connection between them.
choices.visible_reward: Hidden abilities within the Blood Pact Crystal

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the Blood Pact Crystal close to his body. This crystal sealed a wisp of Chen Nian's soul aura—if there was a chance in the future, perhaps he could use this to track his sister. He whispered softly: 'Nian'er, brother will definitely find you.'

The moment Chen Ji tucked the Blood Pact Crystal into his chest, a rumbling sound echoed from the depths of the altar. That temporal-spatial rift hadn't completely vanished—it had shrunk into a tiny slit under Chen Nian's seal, emanating a ghostly blue glow. On the wall beside the slit, a line of characters was distinctly carved.

Chen Ji approached to examine it closely. The handwriting was exactly the same as Chen Nian's: 'Brother, the fourth page of the Tianji Record is deep within the rift, but with the Heavenly Dao's seal, ordinary methods cannot enter. I left this rift as a guide. When you have the ability to open the seal—come find me.'

Chen Ji knelt on one knee, one hand pressed against those carved characters. His shoulders trembled slightly—the cold outer shell he had carefully constructed over thirteen years finally cracked for the first time. His sister had sacrificed herself to enter the temporal-spatial rift for his sake; while he had always thought she was just a victim captured by the Holy Sect.

dialogue.content: She understood you better than you think, and went much further than you imagined.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice rang out in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, carrying a rare gentleness: 'The little girl's using herself as the key to seal the Tianji Record's aura—this technique... even I didn't anticipate it. Not only did she reduce your Heavenly Fate consumption, she also bought you crucial time.'

dialogue.content: Then how do I save her?

First, become stronger. The temporal-spatial rift is the domain of the Heavenly Dao's will—without sufficient strength, entering would be suicide. However... the Blood Pact Crystal she left might be a variable.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng mentioned the Blood Pact Crystal might be a variable. How should Chen Ji respond to this information?

choices.description: Time is pressing—he must immediately figure out the secret hidden in the crystal.

text.content: Chen Ji held the Blood Pact Crystal in his palm, examining it carefully with his divine sense. Inside the crystal was actually a vague map sealed away—that was the route map leading to the core of the temporal-spatial rift—Chen Nian had prepared all of this for him long ago.

choices.description: This place is not safe—he must find a secure location before making further plans.

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the crystal away, quickly scanning the altar to confirm nothing was missed, then returned via his original route. Mo Xiansheng was right—rash action would only harm his sister. He needed a more thorough plan.

The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the altar, the sky was near dusk. He stood atop the ruins, looking back at that silent altar, his heart filled with mixed emotions. For thirteen years, he thought he was protecting his sister, not knowing she had already seen through everything and was protecting him in her own way.

The wind lifted Chen Ji's robes, carrying the fresh fragrance of grass and trees from the distant mountains. He took out the Blood Pact Crystal from his chest, examining it against the setting sun. The crystal's surface reflected his resolute features, and deeper within, there seemed to be a blurry figure smiling at him.

He silently vowed in his heart that no matter what price he had to pay, he would rescue his sister from the temporal-spatial rift. The curse of the Tianji Record, the Holy Sect's pursuit, the Heavenly Dao's calculations—all of this would be trampled beneath his feet.

The Blood Pact Crystal suddenly pulsed warmly, and Chen Nian's message rang out in Chen Ji's mind one final time. It was her last words before leaping into the temporal-spatial rift, carrying unwavering determination: 'Brother, on the path of changing fate, I wish to walk alongside you.'
